items.title: Higher Fuel Costs + Spirit’s End = Higher Fares
items.summary: Although Spirit was a small airline, it had a sizable impact on airfares across major markets in the U.S. Now that it has shut down, industry experts say to expect more airfare increases compounded by high fuel costs.

items.title: Middle East Instability Is Sending Summer Travelers to Spain and the Caribbean, Meliá Says
items.summary: Meliá says instability hurt first-quarter results in some markets while strengthening the summer outlook in others.

items.title: Iran War Costs Have Hit Travel’s Profit Forecasts
items.summary: The Iran war didn't just raise fuel costs — it upended many travel company's business plans for 2026.

items.title: The Middle East Hub Stress Test: What Airlines Build Now Will Define the Next Decade
items.summary: The Iran conflict forced a system-wide stress test on Gulf aviation. Airlines that use this disruption to redesign how they operate will emerge with a structural advantage. Those that simply wait for stability to return will find the window has closed.
